shots.visual_event: Central Station’s master clock races toward 12:13 as the train penetrates the concourse; the cyan memory network remains incomplete.
shots.dialogue_audio: Elias: “We need sixty seconds the train cannot own.”

shots.visual_event: Tick looks from Meera to his thirteenth gear and climbs the clock mechanism on four paws.
Tick nudges Meera’s turquoise clip back into her hair, then locks his segmented tail and all four paws around the escapement.
All thirteen gears leave Tick’s body one by one and enter the master clock; the second hand stops one mark before 12:13.
shots.dialogue_audio: Sound: thirteen distinct mechanical heartbeats, then silence.

shots.visual_event: Across the frozen city, the final voluntary memory slip lights cyan and joins the network.
Tick lies still but intact—clearly a small quadruped fox, never humanoid—while Meera carries him from the gears.
shots.dialogue_audio: Meera: “You are more than the time inside you.”
